rules: No destructive migration of historical sessions, Encounters, event metadata or media.
Classic weight/reps set facts remain v61-owned unless a separately proved owner handoff explicitly retires it.
Existing Objects without explicit metricSchema continue through proven legacy fallback.
Object edits affect future recording only and never rewrite historical Encounter schema/execution snapshots.
Flow is intent/orchestration, not historical truth; skipped, inserted or reordered reality is valid.
A Flow step may temporarily override recording/execution semantics but may not mutate the referenced Object defaults.
Encounter truth must remain valid after its source Flow is edited, reordered or deleted.
Flow provenance is additive context; metricSchemaSnapshot and executionModeSnapshot remain Encounter fact authority.
Flow definitions/current continuity may extend axis_v60_state only under the established app.js owner; no axis_flow_* namespace or new IndexedDB database is allowed.
Temporary Flow recording context may alter only the current recording handoff, never global Object Truth/history/Evolution projections.
No Flow work may create a second Session, Encounter, Active, recorder or persistence owner.
Ordinary single/complete Objects remain canonical-recorder one-shot items; ongoing Flow modes may reuse only the existing v82/v87 Active lifecycle.
Evolution Replay is derived from immutable Encounter truth and may not persist its own timeline, rewrite history, infer scores, or become a media/network/AI owner.
Replay-to-Evidence continuity may only pass transient Encounter identity to the existing v815 Evidence owner.
